groups.name: Adult Formation
groups.description: Adult Formation at Divine Mercy Parish offers opportunities for lifelong growth in faith, helping parishioners deepen their relationship with Christ through staff-led programs and parish groups focused on prayer, devotion, and spiritual growth.

groups.name: Family Catechesis (PreK-5th)
groups.description: Parents and children grow together in the Catholic Faith, celebrating the sacraments and liturgy while equipping parents to guide their children in Christ.

groups.name: Youth Formation (6th-12th)
groups.description: Youth Formation Ministry at Divine Mercy Parish helps middle and high school students encounter Christ through prayer, sacraments, service, and community, connecting faith to real life through weekly gatherings, retreats, and activities.

groups.name: Parish Community & Hospitality
groups.description: Build meaningful relationships by fostering fellowship and creating a welcoming parish community for all.
